verdict.rationale: Bolna has a dedicated call-pricing documentation page (pricing/call-pricing) that explains which components are billed, and states that bring-your-own-key providers are not charged. That indicates a published usage-based pricing model a founder could reason about. However, the evidence contains no actual per-minute rates, plan tiers, or cost calculator, so estimating cost per call cannot be confirmed. Missing for 10: published per-minute rate figures, per-component cost breakdown, cost-per-call estimator or worked example, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see published per-minute or usage pricing and estimate cost per call before committing

citations.quote: When you bring your own keys (BYOK), Bolna does not charge for those components.
We don't charge for any usage for providers that you have connected to Bolna.
you can use your existing SIP trunk provider, your own phone numbers, and your own calling rates.
